title: Yeh Kaisi Anhoni 2
desc: A filmmaking crew stumbles upon a gang of thieves hiding from a mysterious killer in an empty chemical plant. Subsequently, both groups are forced to team up in order to survive and escape.

title: Crocodile Island
desc: Stranded passengers must fight against man-eating crocodiles after their plane makes an emergency landing on a remote island.

title: Businessman 2
desc: A money-minded tycoon gets into a beneficial relationship with a woman. Soon, he learns about the differences in his family and decides to end them.

title: Seetimaarr
desc: A strong-willed coach encounters a series of sinister impediments along his journey to turn a little-known women's kabaddi team into national champions.

title: Roadside Rowdy
desc: A rich businessman's mother enters into a comatose state after an accident and the doctors are unable to cure her. However, a priest promises him that she would recover if he leads a beggar's life.

title: Shivam
desc: Shiva is a carefree lad who helps couples in love marry. Soon, he finds his own heart stolen, while being pursued by enemies determined to break them apart.
